title: Sprint 14 — Conversation Mode & Speaker Diarization
description: Diarization honesty + capacity for conversation mode (ADR-0034). True DER cannot be computed in production (no ground truth), so the honesty signals are the proxy: a diarizer that has started GUESSING shows up as a falling UNKNOWN rate paired with a rising manual-override rate. Read the two together — neither means anything alone. Sprint-14 deployment adds the dual-model capacity row: weighted capacity, per-mode latency, combined window cost, and device memory.

panels.title: Diarization honesty — the DER proxy (review weekly with the clinical lead)
UNKNOWN speaker rate — THE honesty signal
panels.description: unknown / (labeled + unknown + pending) over committed words. Some UNKNOWN is CORRECT and expected — overlapping speech and turn-straddling segments must abstain rather than guess (ADR-0034). A rate near ZERO is the alarming case: it means the clusterer is confidently labeling audio it cannot actually resolve. A rate climbing above ~35% means separation is failing (mic placement, a third voice, near-identical voices). Counted on COMMITTED words only — partials are re-emitted every tick.

panels.title: Manual override rate per session
panels.description: Manual SetSpeakerMapping events / conversation sessions started. Every override is a clinician telling us the inference was wrong (or that it abstained and they assigned it). Rising ⇒ the doctor/patient heuristic is mis-mapping; check whether ASR quality dropped, since the clinician-register vocabulary signal degrades with WER and the inference then abstains by design.

panels.title: Speaker-label outcomes (volume context)
panels.description: Committed conversation words by outcome. 'pending' = diarization had not resolved the speaker when the word committed (labels legitimately trail text by up to one window). Sustained high 'pending' means the clusterer never bootstrapped — usually a single-voice session mistakenly started in conversation mode.

panels.title: Diarization cost per window (p50/p95)
panels.description: VAD + ECAPA embedding + clustering, per 4 s window. Must stay a small fraction of the window budget so the ADR-0013 partial p95 ≤ 1100 ms target holds with both models resident. CPU reference (Apple M5, ADR-0034): p95 ≈ 57 ms ≈ 10% of pipeline. Re-baseline on the A10G rig.

panels.title: Sessions by mode
panels.description: A conversation session costs MDX_CONVERSATION_SESSION_WEIGHT (default 2) capacity slots because it holds two models resident, so 4 dictation OR 2 conversation OR a weighted mix per worker.

panels.title: Conversation starts refused (consent gate)
panels.description: Rate of gpu_full rejections vs consent refusals. A steady consent_refused rate is a WORKFLOW signal, not an outage: clinicians are trying to start conversation mode for encounters whose patient has not granted a 'recording' consent. Sustained gpu_full means the weighted cap needs re-tuning against measured GPU headroom (todo.md, S14).

panels.title: Dual-model capacity — does dictation survive co-tenancy? (sprint-14 deployment)
Live sessions by mode
panels.description: Headcount per worker, split by mode. Read WITH the weighted-capacity panel: two conversation sessions are only 2 sessions but consume the ENTIRE weight budget of 4. Headcount alone makes a full worker look half-idle.

panels.title: Weighted capacity used / budget
panels.description: THE saturation signal. A conversation session costs MDX_CONVERSATION_SESSION_WEIGHT (default 2) because it runs two models; dictation costs 1. When used == max the worker refuses new sessions with gpu_full. Alert: DictationWorkerWeightSaturated.

panels.title: Partial latency p95 BY MODE — the co-tenancy claim
panels.description: Sprint-04's target is p95 <= 1100 ms and it must hold for mode=dictation even while conversation sessions share the worker. If only conversation breaches, suspect the diarizer; if both breach, the worker is oversubscribed — revisit the session weight (ADR-0035). NOTE: sprint 04 declared this metric but never emitted it; it first carries data as of sprint 14.

panels.title: Combined conversation window: inference + diarization
panels.description: The SUM is what has to fit the tick budget — watching Whisper and the diarizer separately hides the case where each is individually fine but their sum is not. Compare against the diarization-only panel above to see which half moved.

panels.title: Inference-device memory utilisation
panels.description: Two models are resident (Whisper + ECAPA/Silero, ADR-0034). kind=vram on CUDA workers (whole-device, so a co-tenant process filling the card shows up here); kind=rss on CPU workers — NOT the same thing, never blend them. Alerts at 0.90 (page) and 0.97 (critical).

panels.title: Conversation readiness + model residency
panels.description: conversation_ready is 0 when the diarizer is cold — the worker still serves dictation (readyz stays 200) so nothing else would notice conversation capacity vanishing. A worker advertising conversation capacity with a cold diarizer would pay weight loading inside its first window.

panels.title: Sessions refused: gpu_full
panels.description: Clinicians being turned away. Sustained refusals mean the fleet is undersized for the current conversation/dictation mix — conversation sessions consume the budget twice as fast.
